status: real NASA-derived regional aggregates; independent scientific review pending
scale_applied: CF decoding; identity scale and zero offset checked
aggregation: monthly source time: mean; exact spherical cell-area weighted means; native .25-degree cells align with region boundaries
fill_values: CF fill/missing decoded to NaN; blanks in CSV; no imputation
quality_rules: 0-100cm requires all three layers finite in the same cell. Negative source cells flagged, not silently discarded. Coverage denominator is entire 10-degree cell including oceans. No universal 0.8 threshold; coverage_review_required remains provisional. Low coverage months require explicit footprint review before statistical interpretation.
footprints: MODIS and GLDAS geographic supports are not confirmed identical. Co-occurrence is only provisional regional screening.
unsupported_cells: Kept in catalog; no fabricated series for cells with no valid GLDAS anywhere in required period.

jurisdictions.method: Shapely intersections; spherical geodesic overlap areas; sorted geographic country candidates only; legal jurisdiction and disputed boundaries require review

reproduction: python scripts/process_regional_gldas.py; source_manifest.json records input hashes
